spans.s:
नत् नत्, त्, त्, त् (fr. rt. नम्), bowing, bowing
one's self, (at the end of comp.)

नत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, bowed, inclined, inclining;
depressed, sunk; crooked, curved; (अम्), n. the
zenith-distance at meridian transit; hour-angle or
the distance of any planet from the meridian; (अस्),
m. the plant Tabernæmontana Coronaria (= तगर,
तगर-पादी).
—नत-कन्धर, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘bowing the neck,’ bowing.
—नत-ज्या, f. the sign
of the hour-angle.
—नत-द्रुम, अस्, m. = लता-
शाल (?).
—नत-नाडी or नत-नाडिका, f. hour-
angle or the distance in time of any planet from the
meridian; any hour of birth after noon or before
midnight.
—नत-नासिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
depressed or flattened nose, flat-nosed.
—नत-
भाग, अस्, m. (in astronomy) zenith-distance.
—नत-भ्रू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, bending the brow, frown-
ing.
—नत-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, bending down the
face, looking down.
—नत-मूर्धन्, आ, आ, अ,
bending or hanging down the head.
—नतांश
(˚त-अं˚), अस्, m. (in astronomy) zenith-distance.
—नताङ्ग (˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, bowing the
limbs, bending the body, bent, curved, bowed,
stooping; (ई), f. a woman.
—नतोन्नत-भ्रू (˚त-
उन्˚), ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, depressing and elevating the eye-
brows, frowning.

नति, इस्, f. bending, bowing, stooping; curvature,
crookedness; a bow, a courtesy, modest behaviour;
(in grammar) the change of a dental letter to a
cerebral; parallax in latitude.

नतमंहस् न-तम्-अंहस्, the beginning of
a particular holy text.

नतराम् नतराम्, ind. (fr. न with the affix
of the compar.), Ved. a strong negative particle
equivalent to ‘not at all,’ ‘never.’

नातिचिर नाति-चिर, अस्, आ, अम्, not very
long (in time), of no long duration; (आत् or ए), ind.
in no very long time, soon.

नातिदूर नाति-दूर (न-अति-द्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
not very distant; (ए), ind. not far from (with abl. or
gen.); (अम्), ind. not very far, no great distance,
not far away.
—नातिदूर-निरीक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, not
seeing very far, not far-sighted.

नातिभिन्न नाति-भिन्न (न-अति-भ्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, not very different from (with abl.).

नातिवाद नातिवाद (न-अत्˚), अस्, m. avoid-
ing opprobrious or abusive language, abstaining from
reproof.

नात्र नात्र, अम्, n. (for नान्त्र), praise,
eulogium; surprise, wonder; (अस्), m. Śiva; a sage.
